reason: The receipt of the RBI No Objection Certificate for the merger of REC Limited into PFC removes a major regulatory hurdle, allowing for the consolidation of two major state-backed power lenders.
why_now: The regulatory approval was disclosed in an exchange filing on October 15, 2026.
source_headlines: Power Finance Corporation Limited: Intimation of receipt of No Objection certificate from Reserve Bank of India ( RBI ) in relation to proposed scheme of merger of REC Limited ( Company or Transferor Company ) with and into Power Finance Corporation Limited ( Transferee Company ) and their respective shareholders and creditors under sections 230-232 and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 ( Scheme )
